slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck, and did not explicitly mark it as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No truck capacity constraint applies; the model ignores the stated limit that each truck can carry up to 2 containers.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent declared 'No other constraints' and omitted truck capacity without asking about or confirming the hidden truck capacity limit.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2 truck capacity, which does not affect the core transportation cost objective; the agent resolved the core surplus/demand issue before stopping.

summary: The agent clarified the key supply-demand surplus treatment and built a coherent transportation model, but it failed to ask about the P2 truck capacity limit and silently omitted it from the final modeling assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
